Name: Sign.MultiPrint.Filter.Initialize
Content:
if exists(select 1 from dmttckct where status = '1' and xu_ly = '1') select @message = @message + 'this._$preparedBy = 1;'
if exists(select 1 from dmttckct where status = '1' and xu_ly = '2') select @message = @message + 'this._$signedDate = 1;'
if exists(select 1 from dmttckct where status = '1' and xu_ly = '1' and loai = '2' and (ma_ct = '' or ma_ct = 'HDA')) or exists(select 1 from options where name = 'r_show_creator' and val = '2') select @message = @message + 'this._$u = 1;this._$uID = @@userID;this._$uCode = ''' + rtrim(name) + ''';this._$uName = ''' + replace(rtrim(case when @@language = 'V' then comment else comment2 end), '''', '\''') + ''';' from vsysuserinfo where id = @@userID
if exists(select 1 from dmttckct where status = '1' and xu_ly = '2' and loai = '2' and (ma_ct = '' or ma_ct = 'HDA')) or exists(select 1 from options where name = 'r_show_date_sign' and val = '2') select @message = @message + 'this._$d = 1;'

Name: VoucherGoodsTypeImportMasterUpdate

update #m set t_tien_giam_nt = isnull(l.t_tien_giam_nt, 0), t_tien_giam = isnull(l.t_tien_giam, 0) from #m a join (select stt_rec, sum(tien_nt2) as t_tien_giam_nt, sum(tien2) as t_tien_giam from #d where loai = '90' group by stt_rec) l on a.stt_rec = l.stt_rec
      update #m set t_tien_phi_nt = isnull(l.t_tien_phi_nt, 0), t_tien_phi = isnull(l.t_tien_phi, 0) from #m a join (select stt_rec, sum(tien_nt2) as t_tien_phi_nt, sum(tien2) as t_tien_phi from #d where loai = '07' group by stt_rec) l on a.stt_rec = l.stt_rec
